description: Hydropathy (Kyte-Doolittle) and Hessa biological membrane-insertion free energy profiles for GLIPR1L2, GLIPR1 and GLIPR1L1, with UniProt signal peptide / TM / SCP domain / GPI site annotations overlaid
code:
import requests, re, json, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"}
def fa(acc):
    r=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",timeout=60,headers=H)
    return "".join(r.text.strip().split("\n")[1:])
S={"GLIPR1L2":fa("Q4G1C9"),"GLIPR1":fa("P48060"),"GLIPR1L1":fa("Q6UWM5")}

# Kyte-Doolittle and Hessa biological ΔG (apparent, kcal/mol; negative = favours membrane insertion)
KD=dict(zip("ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV",[1.8,-4.5,-3.5,-3.5,2.5,-3.5,-3.5,-0.4,-3.2,4.5,3.8,-3.9,1.9,2.8,-1.6,-0.8,-0.7,-0.9,-1.3,4.2]))
# Hessa et al. 2007 Nature, position-independent approximation of ΔGaa (kcal/mol)
HESSA=dict(zip("AILMFVWYGPCSTNQHRKDE",
 [0.11,-0.60,-0.55,-0.23,-0.32,-0.31,0.30,0.68,0.74,2.23,-0.13,0.84,0.52,2.05,2.36,2.06,2.58,2.71,3.49,2.68]))
def win(seq,scale,w=19):
    return np.array([np.mean([scale.get(a,0) for a in seq[i:i+w]]) for i in range(len(seq)-w+1)])
def dG(seq,w=19):   # sum (not mean) of Hessa values over a 19-mer = approximate ΔGapp
    return np.array([sum(HESSA.get(a,0) for a in seq[i:i+w]) for i in range(len(seq)-w+1)])

fig,axes=plt.subplots(3,1,figsize=(13,9),sharex=False)
ann={"GLIPR1L2":{"TM":(254,274),"SP":None,"SCP":(58,192)},
     "GLIPR1":{"TM":(233,255),"SP":(1,21),"SCP":(38,175)},
     "GLIPR1L1":{"TM":None,"SP":(1,22),"SCP":(39,171),"GPI":(221,221)}}
summary=[]
for ax,(g,s) in zip(axes,S.items()):
    kd=win(s,KD,19); g19=dG(s,19)
    x=np.arange(len(kd))+10
    ax.plot(x,kd,color="#2b6cb0",lw=1.4,label="Kyte-Doolittle (w=19)")
    ax.axhline(1.6,color="#718096",ls=":",lw=1)
    ax2=ax.twinx(); ax2.plot(np.arange(len(g19))+10,g19,color="#c05621",lw=1.2,alpha=.8,label="Hessa dGapp (w=19)")
    ax2.axhline(0,color="#c05621",ls="--",lw=.8); ax2.set_ylabel("dGapp (kcal/mol)",color="#c05621",fontsize=8)
    a=ann[g]
    if a["SP"]: ax.axvspan(*a["SP"],color="#38a169",alpha=.25)
    if a["SCP"]: ax.axvspan(*a["SCP"],color="#a0aec0",alpha=.18)
    if a["TM"]: ax.axvspan(*a["TM"],color="#e53e3e",alpha=.3)
    if g=="GLIPR1L1": ax.axvline(221,color="#805ad5",lw=2)
    ax.set_title(f"{g} ({len(s)} aa): hydropathy and predicted membrane-insertion free energy",fontsize=10)
    ax.set_ylabel("KD score",fontsize=8); ax.set_xlim(0,len(s))
    # record minima
    i_min=int(np.argmin(g19))
    summary.append((g,len(s),i_min+1,i_min+19,round(float(g19[i_min]),2)))
    # N-terminal best window (1-60)
    sub=g19[:min(50,len(g19))]; j=int(np.argmin(sub))
    summary.append((g+" [N-term 1-60]",len(s),j+1,j+19,round(float(sub[j]),2)))
axes[-1].set_xlabel("residue position")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

print(f"{'protein':28s} {'len':>4} {'best 19-mer':>14} {'dGapp':>7}")
for r in summary:
    print(f"{r[0]:28s} {r[1]:>4} {str(r[2])+'-'+str(r[3]):>14} {r[4]:>7}")
print("\nNote: dGapp < ~0 kcal/mol => efficient Sec61 membrane insertion (Hessa et al. 2007).")
print("\nGLIPR1L2 N-terminal 60 aa :", S["GLIPR1L2"][:60])
print("GLIPR1   N-terminal 40 aa :", S["GLIPR1"][:40])
print("GLIPR1L1 N-terminal 40 aa :", S["GLIPR1L1"][:40])
print("\nGLIPR1L2 C-term 100 aa    :", S["GLIPR1L2"][-100:])
print("GLIPR1   C-term 45 aa     :", S["GLIPR1"][-45:])
print("GLIPR1L1 C-term 45 aa     :", S["GLIPR1L1"][-45:])
print("\nInternal Met positions in GLIPR1L2 1-120:", [i+1 for i,a in enumerate(S["GLIPR1L2"][:120]) if a=="M"])
